event.summary: Update and shared provider admission preserve distinct copied-state boundaries
event.detail: Reviewed commits: 04ffdbb35773cef36e73eb798c005ddbeb9a9de6 and 56659839785691f76da3af5d8f51b511cff4ba8b. Original consequence considered: Update or shared provider admission might accept copied supervisor identity before first setup checks. TLDR: The Update refusal remains effective after provider dispatch; the new clone path relies on its own prepared-create facts, not on finding an empty state directory after boot. At 04ffdbb service.rs:1324-1332 refuses missing admitted coordinates before probing, and 966-993 uses the guarded ExistingEnvironment registration. At 5665983 the same refusal remains at service.rs:1352-1360, while manager.rs:4185-4196 blocks every environment actor's first dial until both coordinates exist, before even reading provider status. The common installer calls refuse_copied_supervisor before installing (snapshot_preparer.rs:97-99); the backend refuses existing or dangling-link supervisor.db (tensorlake_backend.rs:188-198), then finalization verifies stopped service/cgroup, removes the entire state directory and checks absence before returning facts (233-292). Shared provider admission reads only the created row's saved prepared facts (tensorlake_add.rs:567-592; environment/mod.rs:142-177). Podman create persists the selected facts plus observed login under the expected binding before run (environment/podman.rs:1103-1125; store/podman.rs:256-278); admit_podman_install requires canonical ID and login and compares the complete expected binding before setting coordinates (295-329). Preparation invokes the common installer before image commit (environment/podman/build.rs:345-374). Suggested bucket: highest if copied identity were admitted; could-be-highest: yes. Confidence: confirmed source refutation for Update and the inspected shared admission chain, no execution. proposed_drop: source refutation by pre-probe/pre-dial gates, pre-capture copied-state refusal/whole-state verification, and create-specific saved-facts admission. possible_cover: none. Caveats: a legitimate clone boots its own supervisor and creates its own database before admission, so rechecking state absence on that clone would reject correct behavior; the safety claim depends on the provider's verified prepared image/facts chain, not a fresh empty-database check on the running clone. This is not a complete independent audit of provider build/capture implementations or external image mutation. No missing premise remains for the changed Update route.
